description:
Make the capture layer refuse a whole read of the event log, so a mutation can only probe the log's end.

## Background

`CaptureSpec::discover_paths` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs:566-578`), and `CaptureSpec::new` through it, accept `VirtualPath::EVENTS` as a whole path; only `discover_tail` (`:581-589`) reads its bounded end. Every production capture and every test image already captures the log through `discover_tail`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `CaptureSpec::new` and `discover_paths` return a capture error for `VirtualPath::EVENTS`, and one unit test owns the refusal.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Captures refuse a whole read of the event log
